Tess (CS): Rajan from HelixMed requests APAC demo provisioning for investor showcase next Fri. Needs ap-southeast-1 pin, allowlist 203.0.113.150/32 and 198.51.100.5/32, CORS https://demo.helixmed.ai, qps=180 for 2h (2026-05-05 11:00-13:00 SGT). Scoped demo key limited to model=v1.3 and retention=0. Can infra/security confirm? @Ivy @Owen @Mira
Rajan (HelixMed): Confirming. We'll have ~25 concurrent streams, streaming enabled. Token must expire 4h after end time. Also prefer tenant-isolated pool so traffic doesn't mix.
Ivy (Eng Infra): We can pin tenant=helixmed and create an isolated route pool in ap-southeast-1 with failover to ap-northeast-1. For 180 qps with streaming, reserve 2x g4dn. Will stage ACL entries. Need signed demo AUP before prod push.
Owen (SRE): Reserving 2 nodes now; autoscale min=2 max=3, trigger p95>650ms for 3m. I'll add alerts for CPU, queue latency, and error-rate. Staging ACL updated.
Mira (Security): We'll scope token to the two /32 IPs, model=v1.3, expires=2026-05-05T17:00:00Z, retention=0, and disable request-body logging. Require signed Demo AUP + security addendum. Opening ticket SEC-8012.
Tess (CS): I'll send AUP + short addendum to Rajan and request signature by EOD tomorrow so we can issue the scoped key 24h before demo. Sales marked this account as "high attention" for renewal follow-up.
deploy-bot: Route request queued: route-helixmed-ap-southeast-1 at 4280011229 by Owen (SRE)
Owen (SRE): I'll monitor during the window. Ping #eng-sre if anything spikes and I'll scale to max. Once the signed doc is uploaded, Tess, confirm and I'll push prod ACL and hand over the scoped token.
